description_en: Adds assets to an asset selection operation
description_zh: 为资产选择操作添加资产
name: AddAssetSelectionCriteria

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the asset selection
parameters.help_zh: 本次资产选择的唯一标识
parameters.name: selection_key

parameters.help_en:
The conditions for searching assets. This parameter is in JSON format. Pay attention to the letter case when you specify this parameter.
You can search for assets by instance ID, instance name, VPC ID, region, public IP address, and other conditions. Call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数JSON格式，输入参数时注意大小写。
支持使用资产的实例ID、实例名称、所属VPC ID、地域、公网IP地址等条件搜索资产。您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The operation type for criteria. Valid values:

add: adds assets.
del: deletes assets
parameters.help_zh:
对criteria的操作类型，取值：

add：添加资产
del：删除资产
parameters.name: criteria_operation

fields.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

add: adds the asset.
del: deletes the asset
fields.help_zh:
操作类型。取值：

add：增加。
del：删除
fields.name: operation

fields.help_en: The asset ID. If you select assets by machine, the value is the UUID of the machine. If you select assets by group, the value is the group ID. If you select assets by VPC, the value is the VPC ID
fields.help_zh: 资产ID。按机器选择时，取值为机器的uuid，按分组选择时，取值为分组ID，按VPC选择时，取值为VPC ID
fields.name: target

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
